skillLevels.name: Advanced
points: Fully master receiving, setting, attacking, serving, and blocking techniques
Able to use blocking technique for selected actions
Possess good defensive and offensive serving abilities

skillLevels.name: Upper Intermediate
points: Able to use techniques more consistently
Blocking skill can perform selected actions

skillLevels.name: Intermediate
points: Able to consistently use receiving, setting, and attacking techniques
Blocking skill is limited to basic actions
Serving is limited to underhand serve but has a basic overhand serve

skillLevels.name: Beginner
points: Short volleyball experience and still building proficiency
Serving is limited to underhand serve

skillLevels.name: Newbies
points: New to volleyball with no formal training or match experience
Encouraged to participate in beginner training clinics

rules.title: 1. General Playing Rules / 基本比賽規則
paragraphs: Matches generally follow the current FIVB Official Volleyball Rules, except where modified by Brisbane Magpies Volleyball League Competition Rules.
If there is any inconsistency, Brisbane Magpies Volleyball League Competition Rules take priority.
本聯賽原則上依照現行 FIVB 國際排球總會官方排球規則進行；如有不同，則以本聯賽規則為準。

rules.title: 2. Match Format / 比賽賽制
items: Each match consists of three sets: first set 25 points, second set 25 points, third set 15 points.
Deuce applies where required. A team must win by 2 points.
Around 15 minutes warm-up time will normally be provided before each match, subject to the competition schedule.
Semi-final and final players must have attended at least 2 matches in the first seven weeks. Substitutes with fewer than 2 attendances require opponent approval.
每場比賽共三局；如達至平分，採用 Deuce 制，必須領先 2 分才可勝出該局。

rules.title: 3. Female Player Requirement / 女性球員規定
items: Each team must have at least two female players on court at all times during the match.
This applies throughout every set, rotation, and substitution.
Teams are strongly encouraged to have at least one additional female substitute available.
A male player cannot replace a required female player to satisfy this rule.
If a team cannot maintain at least two female players on court, the team will forfeit the match.
每隊在比賽期間，場上任何時候必須至少有 2 名女性球員。

rules.title: 4. Libero Rules / Libero 規則
items: Super Libero is not permitted.
Standard FIVB Libero rules apply, including back-row restrictions, attacking, and blocking limits.
Only one Libero may be on court at any time.
Libero replacements must not reduce the female-player requirement or be used to bypass it.
本聯賽不允許使用 Super Libero。

rules.title: 5. Team and Player Responsibilities / 隊伍及球員責任
items: Each team is responsible for ensuring it has enough eligible players to complete the match.
Teams should arrange sufficient substitutes for injuries, illness, late arrivals, and absences.
Insufficient eligible players may result in match forfeit.
All participating players must comply with League eligibility requirements.
每隊有責任確保有足夠合資格球員完成比賽。

rules.title: 6. Referee Authority and Final Decisions / 裁判權限及最終決定
paragraphs: The referee is responsible for interpreting and applying the playing rules during the game. Players and teams must respect referee decisions.
Where a situation is not specifically addressed by these Competition Rules, the referee may decide based on FIVB rules, fairness, player safety, and match circumstances.
The referee's decision on all on-court matters is final.
裁判負責比賽期間的判決，所有球員及隊伍必須尊重裁判的決定。

rules.title: 7. Sportsmanship and Conduct / 體育精神及行為
items: Treat referees, opponents, teammates, organisers, and spectators with respect.
Follow reasonable directions given by referees and League organisers.
Avoid abusive, threatening, discriminatory, or aggressive behaviour.
Avoid deliberately dangerous play.
Demonstrate appropriate sportsmanship before, during, and after matches.
所有球員、教練及隊伍代表必須保持良好體育精神。

rules.title: 8. Player Safety and Injuries / 受傷及球員安全
items: Player safety takes priority. A referee or League organiser may stop play if there is an immediate safety concern.
Players are responsible for assessing whether they are physically able to participate.
An injury to a female player does not remove the two-female-player requirement.
If a team cannot maintain at least two female players after an injury, the team will forfeit the match.
球員安全為首要考慮。

rules.title: 9. Waiver and Acknowledgement of Risk / 免責聲明及風險確認
items: All participating players must complete the required waiver and acknowledgement of risk before participating.
Each team is responsible for ensuring its players have completed the required documentation.
A player who has not completed the required documentation may be refused participation.
Nothing in the waiver excludes any right or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded under applicable Australian or Queensland law.
所有參賽球員必須在參加聯賽前完成指定免責聲明及風險確認。

rules.title: 10. Final Interpretation and Administration / 最終解釋及行政決定
paragraphs: The referee's decision is final for all on-court matters during a match.
For matters outside active match play, the decision of Brisbane Magpies Volleyball League organiser will be final, subject to applicable law.
All teams and players are responsible for reading and understanding these Competition Rules before participating.
所有隊伍及球員在參賽前均有責任閱讀及了解本比賽規則。
